title: Technician Dies After Electrocution on Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 Film Set in Chennai

body:
A technician was electrocuted and killed on the sets of Rajinikanth's highly anticipated sequel Jailer 2 during a shoot in Chennai, according to reports from multiple Indian media outlets. The incident occurred during routine setup work, though details about the victim's identity and the specific circumstances remain limited as production house Sun Pictures has not issued a public statement.

The tragedy casts a shadow over what has been one of Tamil cinema's most eagerly awaited productions. Jailer 2, directed by Nelson Dilipkumar, features a star-studded cast including Mohanlal, Jackie Shroff, and newcomer Vidya Balan. The first film grossed over Rs 650 crore worldwide, making it one of the highest-earning Tamil films of all time. A release date of August 12 has been tentatively set.

Workplace safety on Indian film sets has long been a contentious issue. This is not the first such incident involving a Rajinikanth production — a worker died of electrocution on the sets of Kaala Karikaalan in 2017, and another was injured during the Jailer audio launch event in 2023. Industry unions have repeatedly called for stricter safety protocols and mandatory insurance for below-the-line crew, but enforcement remains patchy.

For the global Tamil diaspora, which drives a significant share of opening-weekend box office revenue for films like Jailer, the incident raises uncomfortable questions about the human cost behind the spectacle. Tamil Nadu's booming film industry — projected to be worth Rs 25,000 crore by 2027 — continues to operate with minimal regulatory oversight on set safety.

Production on Jailer 2 has reportedly wrapped, with Rajinikanth completing his portions before this incident became public. Whether the tragedy prompts any delay or public acknowledgment from the makers remains to be seen.
